versions.changelog: 增加新设置人格方法并增加SBTI预设

Soul Generator 2.0.0 — Major update for creating rich AI personas using the 6-section SOUL.md framework.

- Introduced a comprehensive, production-grade 6-section SOUL.md template for AI Agents.
- Added detailed examples, including good, bad, and combined persona definitions.
- Included preset archetypes, MBTI types, and pop culture character templates.
- Provided clear reply rules, personality trait lists, boundaries, and agent routing guidance.
- Expanded documentation and usage instructions to improve agent realism and user experience.
